title: Nextech3D.ai partners with F2B to expand AI-powered event technology business
excerpt: Nextech3D.ai CEO Evan Gappelberg joined Steve Darling from Proactive to discuss the company's new strategic partnership with F2B Services, LLC, aimed at e...
content_html:
Proactive

Wed, August 5, 2026 at 10:23 AM CDT

Nextech3D.ai CEO Evan Gappelberg joined Steve Darling from Proactive to discuss the company's new strategic partnership with F2B Services, LLC, aimed at expanding revenue opportunities across LED display solutions, event technology services, and AI-powered software.

Gappelberg said the partnership combines Nextech's expertise in artificial intelligence and event technology with F2B's capabilities in LED display systems to pursue opportunities in the growing events, exhibitions, corporate communications, retail, hospitality, and experiential marketing sectors.

Under the agreement, the companies will collaborate on LED display installations, LED screen rentals, event technology services, and introduce Nextech's AI-powered software solutions to F2B's customer base. The partnership also creates a framework to identify and pursue additional commercial opportunities as the relationship evolves.

Management believes LED displays are becoming increasingly important as the centerpiece of modern customer engagement, enabling immersive experiences across events, retail environments, educational institutions, entertainment venues, and corporate facilities. Looking ahead, Nextech expects AI, analytics, and digital engagement tools to transform LED networks into intelligent platforms capable of delivering dynamic content, audience insights, automation, and enhanced customer experiences.

Gappelberg said the partnership aligns with Nextech's broader strategy of combining high-value physical infrastructure with AI-driven software to build scalable, recurring revenue streams while positioning the company at the intersection of hardware, software, artificial intelligence, and digital engagement.

content_html_zh:
积极主动的

美国中部时间 2026 年 8 月 5 日星期三上午 10:23

Nextech3D.ai 首席执行官 Evan Gappelberg 与 Proactive 的 Steve Darling 一起讨论了该公司与 F2B Services, LLC 的新战略合作伙伴关系，旨在扩大 LED 显示解决方案、活动技术服务和人工智能驱动软件的收入机会。

Gappelberg 表示，此次合作将 Nextech 在人工智能和活动技术方面的专业知识与 F2B 在 LED 显示系统方面的能力相结合，以在不断发展的活动、展览、企业传播、零售、酒店和体验式营销领域寻求机会。

根据协议，两家公司将在 LED 显示屏安装、LED 屏幕租赁、活动技术服务方面进行合作，并向 F2B 的客户群介绍 Nextech 的人工智能软件解决方案。 该伙伴关系还创建了一个框架，以随着关系的发展识别和寻求更多商业机会。

管理层认为，LED 显示屏作为现代客户参与的核心，变得越来越重要，可以在活动、零售环境、教育机构、娱乐场所和企业设施中实现身临其境的体验。 展望未来，Nextech 预计人工智能、分析和数字参与工具将 LED 网络转变为能够提供动态内容、受众洞察、自动化和增强客户体验的智能平台。

Gappelberg 表示，此次合作符合 Nextech 的更广泛战略，即将高价值物理基础设施与人工智能驱动的软件相结合，打造可扩展的经常性收入流，同时将公司定位于硬件、软件、人工智能和数字参与的交叉点。
